boxes.meaning: viewpoint, way of looking at something

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing a point of view or angle of approach.
This is the all-purpose choice for describing a person's perspective or how something looks from a particular position.
Use this when viewpoint means a particular angle or perspective rather than someone's stated opinion.
Use this for an aspect considered specifically as a viewpoint or angle of analysis.
